tips_en: Start with FDE-Gym, since it crisply frames the gap between benchmark performance and real customer-delivery value—and its evaluation lens is directly relevant to agent systems like OpenGCUA. OpenGCUA is the natural second read: a concrete attempt to close that gap via hybrid GUI/CLI agents with 'harness-to-model decision transfer.' MJev-Spatial is a more specialized paper on fast spatial reasoning; skim it last as a candidate low-latency component for the visual-grounding sub-tasks that computer-use agents need.
tips_zh: 建议先读 FDE-Gym，它清晰地揭示了基准表现与真实客户交付价值之间的差距，其评估视角与 OpenGCUA 等智能体系统直接相关。OpenGCUA 是顺理成章的第二篇：通过混合 GUI/CLI 智能体及"harness-to-model 决策迁移"来弥补这一差距的具体实践。MJev-Spatial 较为专精，聚焦于高效空间推理，可最后略读，作为计算机使用智能体所需视觉定位子任务的潜在低延迟组件。
